role.description: Chief Risk Officer of the group and member of the Management Board. Owns the risk management system of the group: risk strategy and risk appetite, the own risk and solvency assessment, capital and solvency monitoring, operational risk, compliance, information security, data protection, outsourcing and third-party risk, business continuity and model validation. Leads eight department heads and about 70 specialists in four countries. Chairs the group Risk Committee and reports every quarter to the Supervisory Board and its Risk and Audit Committee. Is the main contact for the supervisory authorities in all four countries on risk, solvency, DORA and outsourcing topics and coordinates their inspections and information requests. Works with the group actuarial function on the solvency capital requirement and with Finance on the capital plan and dividend capacity. Leads the group DORA program, the ICT risk framework and the register of information on ICT third-party providers. Owns the group policies for risk, compliance, information security, outsourcing and data protection and their yearly review. Approves risk acceptances, exceptions from policies and material outsourcing contracts. Prepares the group for the new sustainability risk rules and for climate scenario analysis in the ORSA. Supports the CEO in crisis situations, such as major cyber incidents, large claims events and liquidity stress, and runs the crisis management team when it is activated. Works in Slovak, Czech, German and English with colleagues, regulators and the group headquarters.
responsibilities: group risk strategy, risk appetite statement and limit system with yearly review and Supervisory Board approval
own risk and solvency assessment (ORSA), stress tests and climate scenario analysis for all group companies
solvency ratio monitoring, capital plan and dividend capacity together with the CFO and the actuarial function
operational risk framework, loss event database, key risk indicators and risk and control self-assessments
compliance management system, regulatory change management and compliance monitoring plan for the group
information security management system, security incidents and penetration test findings with the CISO
DORA program: ICT risk framework, major ICT incident reporting, resilience testing and ICT third-party register
outsourcing and third-party risk: approval of material outsourcing, due diligence and exit plans
data protection governance, personal data breaches and notifications to the data protection authorities
business continuity management, crisis management team and yearly crisis exercises in every country
internal model governance and independent model validation for pricing, reserving and capital models
risk reports to the Management Board, the group Risk Committee and the Supervisory Board every quarter
ongoing_topics: group DORA program: register of information and threat-led penetration testing preparation
on-site inspection of the supervisory authority on outsourcing and cloud services
ORSA report for this year with new climate scenarios and a cyber stress scenario
review of the risk appetite statement after the acquisition of a pension fund company
replacement of the governance, risk and compliance tool in all four countries
remediation of open findings from the last internal audit of information security
new group policy for artificial intelligence use and model risk
preparation for the sustainability reporting and sustainability risk rules

national supervisory authorities in all four countries
country CEOs of the group companies
department heads in Risk, Compliance and Security

personal data breaches and notification deadlines
Supervisory Board and Risk Committee decisions

request for a risk acceptance before signing

org_context.organization_description: An insurance and pension group with life, non-life and pension companies in Slovakia, Czechia, Austria and Hungary, part of an international financial group, supervised by the national authorities and by the group supervisor at headquarters level.
org_context.mandatory_rule: Mark every email about a supervisory deadline, a major ICT incident, a personal data breach or a whistleblowing report as Urgent, and name the person or team that must act today. Never put the content of whistleblowing reports in the overview; name only the date and the channel.
